data.title: Child Benefit (Kindergeld) decision for daughter Clara
data.case_title: Kindergeld for daughter Clara – Familienkasse Musterfulda
data.explanation: This letter from the Familienkasse confirms that your child benefit (Kindergeld) for your daughter Clara will continue at €259.00 per month starting October 2026, now that she has begun studying at Hochschule Beispielfulda. You need to send in a new enrollment certificate (Studienbescheinigung) before the end of the summer semester so the benefit keeps running. If you disagree with this decision, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Familienkasse; the app shows until when. No other action is needed if you agree with the decision.
data.summary: Familienkasse Musterfulda confirms that Bastian Musterquell will continue receiving child benefit (Kindergeld) of €259.00 per month for his daughter Clara from October 2026, since she is now studying at Hochschule Beispielfulda. A new enrollment certificate is requested by the end of the summer semester, and an objection against the decision can be filed within one month of notification.
data.tax_note: Kindergeld decisions are relevant for the annual tax return because the tax office compares the child benefit received against the alternative child tax allowance (Kinderfreibetrag).

remedy.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterfulda erheben.
